name: LucoPets
title: Calm pet-care web app
description: LucoPets is a calm pet-care web app. Owners plan daily care, grow a Care Garden through care journeys, keep memories and time capsules, celebrate milestones, share care with family and remember pets who have passed.

meta.label: Discipline
meta.value: UX / UI · Web app · Design system

coverCaption: Care, memories and a growing garden

challenge.heading: Daily care that never feels like a chore
paragraphs: Pet apps often nag: streaks at risk, sad pets, pushy upgrades. LucoPets wanted the opposite, a calm place to plan care and keep a pet’s whole story.
It had to cover daily tasks, health records, rewards, memories, family sharing and, with real care, grief when a pet passes.
The goal: warm, soft and reassuring screens where nothing earned is ever taken away.

rows.heading: Rules from 111 client answers
rows.text: I turned the client’s answers into design principles every screen follows: calm, never negative; nothing earned is taken away; the garden is never locked; upgrade asks are gentle; grief is handled with care.
rows.caption: Planner · day view

rows.heading: A soft sidebar, eleven places
rows.text: A floating 120 px sidebar holds Dashboard, Planner, Pet Profile, Garden, Timeline, Celebrations, Capsules, Care Circle, Memorial, Rewards and Settings. A pet switcher in the top bar changes the active pet everywhere.
rows.caption: All pets dashboard

rows.heading: Care grows a garden
rows.text: Days of care grow the Care Garden through journeys with milestones at 25, 50, 75, 90 and 100%. Finished journeys become a Journey Book, then porcelain keepsakes in a cabinet.
rows.caption: Care Garden at 50%

outcome.title: Calm by design
outcome.text: No “streak at risk”, no sad pets. Mood words are only Attentive and Content.

outcome.title: Free stays generous
outcome.text: Premium changes what can be created next; memories, badges and the garden stay free.

outcome.title: A ceramic look
outcome.text: Soft 3D porcelain, warm cream and teal, with neumorphic buttons and real pet photos.
